Prologue

The Arshen Wrym

Before he was Aren, he was no one. A boy with no armor, no blade, no name worth telling. Only a road, and an ember someone once pressed into his hand. They told him it wouldn't last the night. It did. Ahead: a forest where wolves watch from the shadows. A frozen citadel beneath a northern storm. A dead marsh where spirits whisper. A desert of bones. An ancient sentinel. A burning city. A shadow king. And, somewhere past all of it, a dragon. He did not know yet what he would become. Only that the ember was still warm. And that even the longest road starts with one step, marked.

Epilogue

The Second Flame

Years later, children would hear stories about Aren. Some called him the Dragon Slayer. Others called him the Flame Knight. But the oldest storytellers used another name. The Wyrm's Last Guardian. They told of the forest where wolves watched from the shadows. The frozen citadel beneath the northern storm. The dead marsh where spirits whispered. The Desert of Bones. The ancient Sentinel. The burning city. The Shadow King. And finally, the dragon. But every version of the story ended the same way. With a knight walking toward the sunrise. And an ember burning quietly in his hand. Because the First Flame had never truly been destroyed. It had simply passed on. And one day... someone else would be called to carry it.
